title: nutty monsoon algerian chestnut bake
description: a monsoon-inspired, algerian-inspired dish featuring cooked chestnut, cheese-pull, and a hint of brininess, served in a bamboo steamer. perfect for a rainy day or a weeknight meal.
instructions: preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit.
in a large pot, combine the chopped onion and butter. cook over medium heat until the onion is softened.
add the flour to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
slowly add the water to the pot, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
stir in the grated cheese until melted.
add the chopped chestnut, egg, saffron, salt, and black pepper to the pot. stir to combine.
transfer the mixture to a bamboo steamer basket.
place the steamer basket over boiling water and cover with a lid.
steer the mixture for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the chestnut is tender.
remove the steamer from the heat and let it cool for 5 minutes.
sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top of the mixture and serve hot, with a drizzle of lemon juice.
